summary: This 8-K from BMO 2023-C6 Mortgage Trust, filed by deposit BMO Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, reports a routine special servicer transition: effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC replaced Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the BANK5 2023-5YR3 pooling and servicing agreement affecting the 11 West 42nd Street mortgage loan. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved; it is an operational servicing assignment. The filing includes the Assignment and Assumption Agreement as an exhibit. Conservative classification applies — this is a normal administrative event for an asset-backed securities trust, not a special situation.
